'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Piracy in the Gulf of Guinea]]
**[[Pirate]]s [[kidnap]] some crew members of a [[Denmark|Danish]]-owned ship which they later abandon near [[São Tomé and Príncipe]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2023/03/31/Some-crew-members-missing-after-Gulf-of-Guinea-pirate-attack (Al Arabiya)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Tornado outbreak of March 31 – April 1, 2023]]
**The [[Storm Prediction Center]] issues a [[List of Storm Prediction Center high risk days|high risk convective outlook]], the first high risk issued in [[Tornado outbreak sequence of March 24–28, 2021|over two years]], ahead of an expected severe weather outbreak across the [[Mississippi River]] valley in the [[United States]]. [https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/archive/2023/day1otlk_20230331_1630.html (Storm Prediction Center)]
**A large [[tornado]] causes major damage to the [[Little Rock, Arkansas|Little Rock, Arkansas metropolitan area]], killing at least three people and injuring 24 others. [https://www.thv11.com/article/weather/little-rock-catastrophic-tornado/91-f2b6c0d9-b70c-433f-bbe1-9c4570038077 (KTHV-TV)]
**One person is killed and 28 others are injured when a tornado causes the roof of a theater in [[Belvidere, Illinois]], to collapse during a concert. [https://www.wifr.com/2023/04/01/mass-casualty-event-reported-belvideres-apollo-theatre/ (WIFR-TV)]
*[[Indore stepwell collapse]]
**Thirty-six people are killed and 17 others are injured when a [[stepwell]] collapses during prayers at a [[Hindu temple]] in [[Indore]], [[Madhya Pradesh]], [[India]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/mar/30/people-trapped-in-well-in-indore-india-after-temple-floor-collapses (The Guardian)]
*[[2023 Pakistan ration distribution stampedes]]
**Eleven people die after being [[Crowd collapses and crushes|crushed in a crowd]] which gathered to collect food outside a factory in [[Karachi]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/3/31/stampede-at-food-distribution-centre-kills-11-in-pakistan (Al Jazeera)]
*Four people are killed by [[avalanche]]s in [[Northern Norway]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/three-killed-including-foreign-tourist-in-norway-avalanches-police-1a7b02cf (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
*More than a dozen people are injured in separate incidents after two trains [[derailment|derail]] during a storm in [[Switzerland]]. [https://apnews.com/article/switzerland-train-derail-bern-transportation-injuries-e7cd77633dd19d1eb49096d4530cbc85 (AP)]
